# Timer:stringValue

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.8</span></div>

Return the timer value as a string.

```lua
local value = timer:stringValue()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

value (string)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
timer = model.getTimer(0)
print(timer:stringValue())
```
